verdict.rationale: Figma's official MCP server documents tools for reading designs out of Figma and turning a selected frame into code, so an agent can programmatically export designs to a production format (code). The pack never documents rendering designs to screenshots or images through the MCP server or REST API. The REST API evidence covers only extracting objects, layers and their properties, and community SVG export is manual or done through a third-party plugin. Missing for 10: documented screenshot/image rendering endpoint or tool, documented image/SVG/PDF export formats, independent hands-on corroboration of agent-driven export.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface
